description: List of names and numbers. In Judaeo-Arabic and Greek/Coptic numerals. Entires include: Jamāl Ṣāʾigh; Shemuʾel [...] Kohen; Najm(?) al-Shāmī; [...]; ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. Abū ʿAlī; Rashīd Ibn al-Ṭaḥḥān; Abū l-Majd Ibn al-Aʿsar(?); [...] b. Muwaffaq; Maḥāsin Ḥazzān; Fuhayd Kohen; [...] al-Ṣāʾigh; Yosef Ibn al-Muʾajjir(?); [...] b. Mukhtār. Dating: likely 12th or 13th century.
